Enum Class Age

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Age>
it.polimi.ingsw.model.game.Age
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Age>, Constable
public enum Age extends Enum<Age>
Represents the ages (eras) the game progresses through. Each age carries a numeric value used for scoring and penalties; AGE_3_FINAL shares the numeric value of AGE_3 but acts as a non-playable overflow deck rather than a distinct playable age.
